written: 2026-10-14, before any Combine-feature vs game-trait/outcome association was computed
hypothesis: How much speed a WR carries through 90-degree breaks in Combine route drills (speed out, dagger, slot sail, post-corner) is a player trait that transfers to the same mechanic on regular-season OUT/IN routes and to separation at the throw on breaking routes, beyond traditional Combine times and draft capital. Secondary mechanic: braking into stop routes (curl/comeback/slot strike) transfers to braking on game HITCH routes.
population: Combine position WR (main). Unit = player. Regular-season games only.

primary_tests.rationale: Same mechanic on both sides: fraction of entry speed kept at the slowest point of a 90-degree break. Combine composite reliability 0.56 (4 drills, cross-drill ICC 0.27); game trait split-half 0.77; composite nearly orthogonal to B2 controls (in-sample R2 0.12, n=107).

Speed carried through the break should create separation at the throw on the routes where the break happens. Separation over expected restricted to HITCH/OUT/IN plays (split-half 0.41); all-route SOE is unreliable (0.15). Game outcome: also reported without the 2025 class.

Braking into a stop (curl/comeback/slot strike) vs braking into a hitch: the same stop-and-turn movement. Game trait split-half 0.79. KNOWN A PRIORI: Combine composite reliability 0.44 < 0.5 (go criterion 5 fails regardless of the result).

definitions.combine_events: src/bdb27/probes/a_route_breaks.py: canonicalize attempts (segments.canonicalize), Savitzky-Golay kinematics, one break per attempt. STOP drills (CURL_ROUTE_RIGHT, COMEBACK_ROUTE_RIGHT, SLOT_STRIKE_ROUTE_LEFT): first frame after onset where speed < 0.5 x running peak (peak >= 3 yd/s), entry = stem peak, stop frame = first frame within 0.2 yd/s of the min speed in the next 1.2 s, path distance of the stop inside a per-drill window. TURN drills (SPEED_OUT_ROUTE_LEFT + SPEED_OUT_LEFT pooled, DAGGER_ROUTE_LEFT, SLOT_SAIL_ROUTE_RIGHT, POST_CORNER_ROUTE_LEFT): sharpest net heading change over +-half_window inside a per-drill path-distance window (|turn| >= min_turn), break frame = slowest frame within +-half_window of it, entry = fastest frame in the previous 1 s (>= 3 yd/s). Windows and thresholds in DRILLS were set from QC plots of paths and speed curves only.
definitions.retention: speed at the break frame / entry speed
definitions.peak_decel: max of -a_tan (yd/s^2) between the entry frame and the break frame
definitions.c_turn_retention: attempt-mean retention per player x turn drill, z-scored within drill (WRs), averaged over drills; players with >= 2 turn drills
definitions.c_stop_peak_decel: same construction for peak_decel over the 3 WR stop drills; players with >= 2 stop drills
definitions.game_events: REG-season WR/TE route plays (player_play.route_ran, not nullified), snap-aligned. t_end = first of pass_forward/pass_shovel/qb_sack/qb_strip_sack/run, capped at 4 s. HITCH: same STOP algorithm from 0.5 s after the snap; the stem peak must be at or before t_end. OUT/IN: same TURN algorithm (min_turn 45, half_window 0.5) with the sharpest turn in [0.5 s, t_end + 0.5 s].
definitions.g_turn_retention: per-play retention on OUT/IN minus the route-type mean (all WR/TE events), player mean shrunk by empirical Bayes toward the WR mean (normal-normal, method-of-moments tau2, pooled within-player sigma2); players with >= 10 events
definitions.g_stop_peak_decel: same for peak_decel on HITCH events
definitions.soe_hoi: separation_at_pass_forward minus a cross-fitted (GroupKFold by player, 5 folds) HistGradientBoosting prediction from route_ran, team_coverage_man_zone, team_coverage_type, receiver_alignment, lined_up_position, offense_formation, in_motion_at_ball_snap, dropback_duration, down, yards_to_go, yards_to_goal, quarter (model fit on all non-SCREEN WR/TE plays; cushion and pass_length excluded). Player mean over HITCH/OUT/IN plays, EB-shrunk as above; players with >= 20 such plays.

evaluation.harness: bdb27.linkage.evaluate(df, feature, target), df = linkage.player_table() joined to features/targets, WR only
evaluation.go_criteria: PLAN.md section 4: excess dR2 - 1 SE > 0, Freedman-Lane perm p < 0.05, LOCO dR2 > 0 in >= 2/3 classes, reliability >= 0.5, stable over 3 seeds, scout-explainable
evaluation.multiple_testing: 3 primary tests; report BH-FDR across the 3 perm p-values

reliability_before_prereg.TE: Combine TE composites unreliable (1 stop drill; turn composite <= 0.41) and TE game turn traits unreliable (n=31 events median) -> TE only in an exploratory pooled sensitivity

decisions_made_before_prereg: Excluded Combine SLANT_ROUTE_LEFT, CORNER_ROUTE, POST_CORNER_ROUTE_RIGHT, WHEEL_ROUTE_LEFT, GO_ROUTE_RIGHT: smooth arcs with no identifiable break on QC plots
Game turn traits use OUT/IN only: SLANT/CORNER/POST/CROSS are gradual bends (detection 40-60%)
SOE target restricted to HITCH/OUT/IN plays because all-route SOE has split-half reliability 0.15
Main population WR; TE too small and unreliable
planned_exploratory: X1: P1-P3 with combine_top_speed added as a control (is it just the E001 speed signal?)
X4: c_turn_retention -> SOE on all non-screen routes and on non-GO routes
